component.name: Snow Shot
component.summary: Capture, annotate, pin and recognize screen content
截取、标注、贴图与文字识别屏幕内容

description.p: Snow Shot captures a region, a window or a scrolling page, annotates the result with shapes, text and mosaics, and keeps it available on top of other windows.
Text and table recognition run on the same captured image, so a screenshot can be turned back into selectable content without leaving the application.

ul.li: Region, window, current-monitor and scrolling capture
Shape, pen, text and mosaic annotation
